body.name: Zi
body.def: If arrival \(i\) is stored, \(Z_i\) is assigned immediately by a private fair coin. If later arrival \(i_k\) completes an edge with stored member \(j_k\), then \(Z_{i_k}=1-Z_{j_k}\), equivalently \(Z_{j_k}=(1+\varepsilon_k)/2\) and \(Z_{i_k}=(1-\varepsilon_k)/2\).
body.role: Immediate treatment assignment whose private randomization is excluded from the matching rule.
